subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub continue to support an operator-run recovery path for creating or repairing a GitHub Release after a successful npm publish, and if so where is that contract owned?
rationale: The deleted workflow is an operational recovery contract; source review cannot determine whether maintainers intentionally accept removing it or have approved an equivalent outside this branch.

options.title: Preserve an explicit recovery path
options.body: Keep the workflow or replace it with a documented, access-controlled equivalent that repairs GitHub Release creation without republishing npm.

options.title: Retire recovery support intentionally
options.body: Approve removal only if release owners explicitly accept manual or unsupported recovery after a partial publish and update operational documentation accordingly.

recommendation.title: Preserve an explicit recovery path
recommendation.body: Keep the workflow or replace it with a documented, access-controlled equivalent that repairs GitHub Release creation without republishing npm.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the only concretely identified contributor for this release-automation change, though the permanent operational policy needs broader release-owner confirmation.
